features.name: Send Command
features.description: Dispatches one command and counts how many times its handler ran.

features.name: Send Query
features.description: Dispatches one query and returns the answer its handler computed.

features.name: Publish Notification
features.description: Publishes one notification to three handlers of the same type.

features.name: Pipeline Behavior
features.description: Dispatches one query through an application-supplied pipeline behavior.

features.name: Exception Behavior
features.description: Dispatches a query whose handler throws and recovers through the exception extension point.

features.name: Async Handler
features.description: Awaits one query handler that completes asynchronously.

features.name: Source Generated Dispatch
features.description: Dispatches one query through a compile-time generated registry.

features.name: Register
features.description: Builds the container, registers the handlers and resolves the dispatcher.
